name: Materials & Inputs
desc: Physical feedstock for chipmaking — wafers, specialty gases, photoresist chemicals.

name: Semiconductor Equipment
desc: The machines that make chips. ASML holds a monopoly on EUV lithography.

name: Chip Design
desc: Architect the silicon, mostly fabless. Nvidia dominates AI accelerators.

name: Foundry & Manufacturing
desc: Designs become physical wafers. TSMC handles ~90%+ of leading-edge AI silicon.

name: Memory
desc: HBM, DRAM, NAND — the genuine bottleneck on accelerator output.

name: Advanced Packaging
desc: Stitching logic and memory into a finished accelerator. CoWoS capacity is the key chokepoint.

name: Systems, Networking & Power
desc: Chips into deployable, powered racks. Optical transceivers are the inter-rack bandwidth chokepoint.

name: Compute Providers
desc: Hyperscalers and neoclouds — the layer that actually deploys compute at scale.

name: Model Labs & End Demand
desc: The labs building frontier models and their end buyers — sovereign AI, enterprise, government.
